1Before you go

🛣️ Overland route options

Highway 40 (Route 80M – main route)

Itinerary: Doha → Salwa border → Hofuf → Riyadh → Al Quwayiyah → Dhalm → Taif → Makkah.

The safest road, lit for most of its length, with the newest model stations (SASCO and Aldrees).

Distance: 1,455 km
📍 Start trip

Riyadh bypass route

Itinerary: Doha → Salwa → Khurais Road → King Salman Road (the new northern ring road) to join the Hejaz road.

Recommended to avoid central Riyadh traffic at peak hours (7 am – 5 pm).

Distance: 1,485 km
📍 Start trip

2On the road

⚠️ Road tips and safety

😴 Fatigue and drowsiness: Never push on when you feel sleepy. Stop at the nearest service station right away and take a 20-minute nap.

☕ Rest stops: Stop every 250–300 km (every 2 to 3 hours) to stretch and refresh. Avoid driving for more than 3 hours straight, and share the driving if you can.

📸 Saher speed cameras: The speed limit is 140 km/h on most expressways for small cars. Wear your seat belt and avoid using your phone while driving.

🐪 Stray camels: Watch out for stray camels, especially at night and in the early morning, from Salwa to Khurais and from Al Quwayiyah to Taif.

📱 SIM cards: Operators include STC, Mobily and Zain. Activate a roaming package or get a data SIM or an eSIM to make maps and delivery apps easier to use.

🤲 Travel supplications

Travel supplication: "الله أكبر، الله أكبر، الله أكبر، سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين وإنا إلى ربنا لمنقلبون. اللهم إنا نسألك في سفرنا هذا البر والتقوى ومن العمل ما ترضى، اللهم هوّن علينا سفرنا هذا، واطوِ عنا بعده، اللهم أنت الصاحب في السفر، والخليفة في الأهل، اللهم إني أعوذ بك من وعثاء السفر، وكآبة المنظر، وسوء المنقلب في المال والأهل" وإذا رجع قالهنّ وزاد فيهنّ: آيبون، تائبون، عابدون، لربنا حامدون. "Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to us, for we could never have done it ourselves, and to our Lord we shall surely return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from distressing sights, and from an evil return in wealth and family." On the way back one says the same and adds: "We return, repenting, worshipping and praising our Lord."

When stopping at a place or rest area: "أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق" "I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created."

While driving: Say takbir (Allahu Akbar) when going uphill and tasbih (Subhan Allah) when going downhill.

3In Makkah and Madinah

🏨 Staying and getting around in Makkah and Madinah

🏨 Hotels and parking: Book hotels in advance and make sure parking is available, or use the official car parks at the entrances to Makkah (such as Kudai or Az-Zahir) and take the Makkah shuttle buses to the Haram.

🚕 Getting around: Use apps such as Uber and Careem to get around Makkah and Madinah at clear, regulated prices.

🚄 Haramain High-Speed Railway: An excellent, comfortable way to travel between Makkah and Madinah (about 2 hours 20 minutes). Book tickets early through the Haramain railway app or website.

💧 Zamzam water: Officially bottled Zamzam water can be bought from 📍 the King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz Zamzam Water Project in Makkah (Kudai district).
